gen-gf-unica-one-gf-numans: Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with a huge lowercase eye. It is the loud, stripped-down voice here, while Numans answers by spacing its sans letters far apart, with ends that hang off the spine.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-onest: Crisp and friendly, with Unica One's uniform strokes up top and Onest's short ascenders over generous bowls underneath. They sit together comfortably, one assertive, one easygoing.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-open-sans: Commanding is how Unica One comes across, a plain stripe of constant ink with visible daylight inside every curve. And Open Sans follows with smooth, bulky lowercase and no clogged curves, so the heading keeps all the drama.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-orienta: Unica One keeps one unmodulated line across every glyph, with a very large lowercase eye. Orienta, in sans-serif form, lets its counters breathe and keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, so the two share the page without crowding.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads clean and contemporary, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its curves never closing back on themselves. And Unica One above it looks marker-traced, so a long run of the sans underneath feels open while the heading stays distinctive.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-parkinsans: Unica One draws each stroke at a single thickness, with a very large lowercase eye and daylight inside every curve. Parkinsans matches that discipline, crisp even when shrunk.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme reads modern and clean, with clear openings in its rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Pathway Extreme can go modest in size, while Unica One, with its drafting-pen line, is better kept large.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-preahvihear: Unica One has no tapering at all, as if a quill never pressed harder, and its lowercase eye is huge. Preahvihear opens each letter like a pried oyster shell under a lofty x-height, so a long passage would feel spacious.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-prompt: Prompt reads approachable, its small letters oversized and its apertures easily open. But Unica One, cut like a stencil at one steady width, is the one to carry the headline's weight, leaving Prompt to do the quiet work.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-pt-sans-caption: Loud and lean, Unica One has tails and terminals as thick as its stems. And PT Sans Caption follows with big-bodied lowercase and inviting, unclosed bowls, so Unica One earns its keep big and brief.
